contract: infer_tree(alignment, substitution_model, budget_seconds) -> semicolon-terminated Newick tree. Alignment maps taxon names to DNA strings. Each input taxon exactly once; finite branch lengths0..100. Independently calculate JC69 pruning likelihood; minimize mean negative log-likelihood per alignment site. Empirical likelihood is not true-topology accuracy.
